subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should `agents_list` expose operator-authored agent descriptions to every requester already authorized to discover that target, and what bounds must apply to that model-visible text?
rationale: The remaining code change is small, but exposing free-form config text through an agent tool establishes a prompt and information-visibility contract that repository history and tests cannot choose automatically.

options.title: Expose bounded descriptions
options.body: Return trimmed, length-bounded descriptions only for targets already admitted by the existing `agents_list` authorization filter, with focused security and omission tests.

options.title: Keep metadata operator-only
options.body: Retain `description` in configuration and administrative views but do not expose it to model-facing `agents_list` output.

options.title: Defer dynamic discovery
options.body: Leave runtime discovery unchanged and close the linked implementation until a broader agent-roster contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Expose bounded descriptions
recommendation.body: Return trimmed, length-bounded descriptions only for targets already admitted by the existing `agents_list` authorization filter, with focused security and omission tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history across `agents_list`, multi-agent routing, the relevant config paths, and the prior issue-level review.
